name: openelec-genie-web
description: Demo React site that delivers the OpenElectricity Genie space outside the Databricks UI via the Genie Conversation API.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run typecheck -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
